_readme: One entry per blog post (file blog-<slug>.html). 'image' is the cover: either /assets/blog/<slug>.webp (with its crops <slug>.jpg, -og.jpg, -4x3.webp, -1x1.jpg alongside) or a Cloudinary URL (crops made on the fly). Leave it empty to keep the image already in the page. 'alt' describes what is IN the image. Run: node scripts/blog-images.mjs. The admin panel (Blog -> Cover images) can override both live without a redeploy.
